name: NCT Alliance Berhad
overview: NCT Alliance 今年通过子公司 NCT World 拟以 RM53.0 million 认购 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 80% 扩大后股权，并通过 NCT Panorama 拟以 RM22.0 million 收购 NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权（条件期限已延长）。同时，NCT Land 与 Guangzhou Great Power Energy & Technology 签署的谅解备忘录/协议在年内多次公告中均无重大进展。
overview_en: NCT Alliance this year proposed to subscribe for an 80% enlarged equity interest in Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. for RM53.0 million via subsidiary NCT World, and proposed to acquire a 51% equity interest in NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd. for RM22.0 million via NCT Panorama (conditional period extended). Meanwhile, the memorandum of agreement/understanding between NCT Land and Guangzhou Great Power Energy & Technology showed no material development in multiple announcements during the year.

segments.name: 房地产开发
segments.note: 今年推进两项股权收购，以扩大房地产开发项目组合。
segments.note_en: The company pursued two equity acquisitions this year to expand its property development project portfolio.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT World 与 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 及相关股东签署补充协议，修订 RM53.0 million 认购 80% 股权的条款。
actions.text_en: NCT World entered into a supplemental agreement with Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. and its shareholders to vary terms of the RM53.0 million subscription for an 80% equity interest.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT Panorama 拟以 RM22.0 million 收购 NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权的条件期限进一步延长三个月至 2026 年 12 月 19 日。
actions.text_en: Conditional period for NCT Panorama's proposed acquisition of a 51% equity interest in NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd. for RM22.0 million was further extended by three months to 19 December 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT World 拟以 RM53.0 million 认购 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 8 股新普通股（占扩大后股权 80%）的公告经修订。
actions.text_en: Amended announcement on NCT World's proposed subscription of 8 new ordinary shares in Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. for RM53.0 million (80% of enlarged equity interest).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT Panorama 拟以 RM22.0 million 收购 NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权的条件期限获延长。
actions.text_en: Conditional period for NCT Panorama's proposed acquisition of a 51% equity interest in NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd. for RM22.0 million was extended.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT World 与 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 签署有条件股份认购及股东协议，拟以 RM53.0 million 认购 8 股新普通股，占扩大后股权 80%。
actions.text_en: NCT World entered into a conditional shares subscription and shareholders' agreement with Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. to subscribe for 8 new ordinary shares for RM53.0 million, representing 80% of the enlarged equity interest.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT World 与 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 签署条款清单，拟以 RM53.0 million 认购 998 股新普通股。
actions.text_en: NCT World entered into a term sheet with Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. to subscribe for 998 new ordinary shares for RM53.0 million.
